SOO1.title: Evaluating the research productivity of a state university in Central Luzon, Philippines: Basis for policy recommendations
SOO1.journal: International Journal of Evaluation and Research in Education (IJERE)
SOO1.soo_rationale: Directly analyzes faculty research productivity metrics, publication outputs, and institutional monitoring policies in a Philippine State University, providing localized empirical benchmarks for PSU Asingan.

SOO2.title: Digital Learning Policies and Library Governance: A Comparative Policy Analysis of CHED and DepEd Initiatives in the Philippines
SOO2.institution: Philippine Normal University / Commission on Higher Education (CHED)
SOO2.soo_rationale: Investigates national Philippine digital repository governance, scholarly indexing standards, and institutional author identity metadata compliant with CHED institutional tracking criteria.

SOO3.title: Integrating sustainable development goals in Philippine higher education: Research agendas and community engagement
SOO3.soo_rationale: Examines the concrete operationalization of the UN Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs) within Philippine state colleges and universities, validating PSU Asingan’s SDG research alignment module.

SOO4.title: MediCord: A Web-Based Health Record Management System Using Agile Software Development Lifecycle
SOO4.institution: Nueva Ecija University of Science and Technology (NEUST)
SOO4.journal: Journal of Humanities, Technologies and Social Sciences
SOO4.soo_rationale: Provides local architectural and agile development lifecycle documentation for engineering responsive web-based management platforms in Central Luzon state university settings.

SOO5.title: Empowering Bantayan Island Through a Centralized Digital Repository: An Evaluation Using ISO/IEC 25010 and UTAUT
SOO5.journal: International Journal of Educational Research and Interdisciplinary Studies
SOO5.soo_rationale: Conducts rigorous software quality evaluation using the ISO/IEC 25010 international standard (functional suitability, performance, usability) in a Philippine university deployed web system.
